_comment: Multi Neuraxon Game of Life 5 — world & server config. Edited via the admin console or by hand (admin reboot to apply world-shape changes; most server caps are live).
_v141_notes: Recommended values for the path to 1000s of NxErs. Three changes vs the prior live config, each explained: (1) agmp_enabled=false — skip the reward-less per-step plasticity pass for a ~20-25% cheaper brain step (NEW knob, needs v1.41+; trinary science preserved by separate homeostasis; reversible). (2) mate_cooldown_ticks 300000->6000 — at 300000 it was ~7 HOURS between matings per NxEr so reproduction was effectively OFF and the population was pinned at the respawn floor (~50-95); 6000 lets well-fed NxErs breed so the population can actually grow. (3) max_food 1800->3600 and brain_step_every 5->8 — feed a larger population and keep TPS sane as it climbs (raise brain_step_every further, e.g. 15-25, once past a few hundred NxErs).
